mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of months when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of months when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases by at least 50,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, residential construction permits exceeding 1.3 million units signal robust housing demand that supports economic growth and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 35% of months when HOUST exceeds 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer spending index (RSAFS) signals strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when RSAFS increases by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction permits and industrial production signals broad-based economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of months when HOUST increases and INDPRO increases by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 jobs, it signals a strong labor market that may lead to wage inflation and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 55% of months when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0.
